title: Wadjet Hall
summary: Successive rulers changed the hall’s columns, roofs, royal statues and obelisk setting.
orientation: Between the Fourth and Fifth Pylons.

claims.text: Successive rulers changed the hall’s columns, roofs, royal statues and obelisk setting.
Hatshepsut replaced earlier stone supports with gilded wooden papyrus-form columns; later work again substituted stone. The surviving phase is not the only ancient design.

citations.locator: Phases of Construction: Hatshepsut; Thutmose III

claims.text: The centre needed an opening for the obelisks while side sections were roofed.

caveats: Field access and demonstration viewpoints are unverified; this is an editorial research draft.
